title: Monoidal 2-categories from foam evaluation
summary: In this paper we describe a general framework for constructing examples of locally linear semistrict monoidal 2-categories covering many examples appearing in link homology theory. The main input datum is a closed foam evaluation formula. As examples, we rigorously construct semistrict monoidal 2-categories based on gl(N)-foams, which underlie the general linear link homology theories, and further examples based on Bar-Natan's decorated cobordisms, related to Khovanov homology. These monoidal 2-categories are typically non-semisimple, have duals for all objects, adjoints for all 1-morphisms,…
